description: Phase 6: with several sites and the engine's camera, camera.start names the site whose start view the one camera starts at (storm-riverlands: the river). The camera is there before the first frame, and the river site's own camera follows it.

steps.label: the camera starts at the river's start view
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.startSite, v = entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld(s.world.view); return entities.fly.view.pos.map((x, i) => Math.abs(x - v.pos[i])); })()

steps.label: the river's camera follows the one camera
steps.expr: (() => { const s = entities.startSite, v = entities.siteFrame(s).toWorld(s.world.view); return entities.fly.view.pos.map((x, i) => Math.abs(x - v.pos[i])); })()
